subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split Feishu outbound hook parity from normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening, and require the outbound fix to follow the existing exactly-once hook-bypass track?
rationale: The outbound bug is source-reproducible, but `inbound_claim` changes claim authority and plugin ordering, while overlapping PRs already touch the shared outbound hook seam.

options.title: Split outbound parity first
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage through the shared exactly-once hook path and keep normal-channel `inbound_claim` on a separate API/security tracker.

options.title: Fold into hook umbrella
options.body: Move the Feishu acceptance criteria under the broader outbound-hook coverage issue and use this item mainly for the inbound-claim API question.

options.title: Solve all hooks together
options.body: Land one broader design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity first
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage through the shared exactly-once hook path and keep normal-channel `inbound_claim` on a separate API/security tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal on plugin hook semantics through the plugin-surface merge and adjacent hook-hardening commits.
